steps.say: Our bodies need care every day to stay healthy.
Eat many kinds of food, like rice, vegetables, fruit and eggs. Sweets are a treat.
Drink water every day, and more when it is hot.
Exercise makes your heart and muscles strong. Sleep helps your body grow.

figure.alt: A child running and a bed for sleep.

steps.say: Wash your hands with soap before eating. Brush your teeth twice a day.

figure.alt: A bar of soap and a toothbrush.

check.prompt: When should you wash your hands?

options.why: Hands need washing many times every day.
Germs are too small to see.
Wash hands at many times each day, like before eating.

hints: Think about when germs could get into your mouth.
Ask: what do your hands touch just before a meal?
check.explanation: We wash our hands before eating so germs do not get onto our food.

options.why: Sugar left on teeth can make holes in them.
Teeth need brushing every morning and night.
Fizzy drinks have lots of sugar.

hints: Think about what you do each morning and night.
Which choice cleans the teeth often?
Ask: what is a toothbrush for?
check.explanation: Brushing twice a day cleans food and germs off our teeth.
